title: Subsets II
description:
# Subsets II

Given an integer array `nums` that may contain duplicates, return *all possible subsets (the power set)*.

The solution set **must not** contain duplicate subsets. Return the solution in **any order**.

## Example 1:

**Input:** nums = [1,2,2]
**Output:** [[],[1],[1,2],[1,2,2],[2],[2,2]]

## Example 2:

**Input:** nums = [0]
**Output:** [[],[0]]

## Constraints:

*   `1 <= nums.length <= 10`
*   `-10 <= nums[i] <= 10`

solutions.name: Backtracking with Sort + Skip Duplicates
solutions.description: Sort the array first. Use backtracking like Subsets I, but skip duplicate elements at the same level: if nums[i] == nums[i-1] and i > start, skip.

solutions.name: Iterative Build-Up
solutions.description: Sort the array. Start with an empty subset. For each new element, if it equals the previous element, only extend the subsets added in the last round (to avoid duplicates). Otherwise, extend all existing subsets.
